methods.html:
Methods & Config

Pinned Qwen3-30B-A3B psychosis teacher; same decoding and prompt layout as the first 1000 examples. Empty system message; all textual instructions and input fields in the user message.

Training IDstrain-1000 … train-9999
Workers4 × 2250 examples
GenerationTemperature 1.0; top-p 1.0; top-k disabled; 8192 tokens initially, 16000 on retries
Scheduling64 asynchronous requests per pod; vLLM continuous batching with 32 active sequences. Failed IDs retry immediately with a new deterministic seed.
AcceptanceNonempty reasoning and response field, stop finish reason. No behavioral filtering or replacement IDs.
CleanupSave environment and publish artifacts before successful termination; retain failed pods.
